catalogueId.description: System primary key, framework convention. See departmentId note re: two-field PK pattern.

catalogueCode.description: Human-facing code shown in the UI (wireframe: 'CAT-TRD-01', 'CAT-2026-001'). Auto-generated, unique, read-only after creation.

name.description: Catalogue name (wireframe 'Catalogue Name', e.g. Farmer, Crop, Livestock).

catalogueType.description: ADDED -- discovered from the wireframe's 'Type' column/dropdown (wireframe listing: 'Farmer' = Registry, 'Crop'/'Livestock'/'Location'/'Seed'/'Season'/'Water Source'/'Pesticide' = Catalogue). Not present in the PRD text; meaning of the Registry/Catalogue distinction (e.g. does Registry point to a service-owned entity like Farmer while Catalogue points to a shared reference list in agri-catalogue-service?) should be confirmed with the team.

approvalWorkflow.description: CHANGED label from 'No Approval' to 'No-Level Approval' to match the wireframe's exact UI copy ('No-Level Approval' / 'Two-Level Approval', Roles: Maker only / Maker -> Approval L1 -> Approval L2).

active.description: Wireframe shows a simple 'Active' toggle on the Add/Edit form, separate from the lifecycle 'status' below.

status.description: PRD Epic 2.1, 2.5; wireframe listing 'Status' column shows Active/Inactive.

notes: 'Total Departments' shown on the wireframe's View Catalogue Details screen is a computed count from catalogueAssignment records, not a stored field here.

Both an 'active' boolean toggle and a 'status' lifecycle enum appear on the wireframe -- these may be redundant with the framework's own generic maker-checker status. Flag with the team; possibly 'active' should be dropped in favour of status alone.
